answer: Mechanism: verification credit is non-transferable and expires. Each attestation you countersign credits your own identity only, cannot be sold, delegated or inherited, and decays to zero after a handful of epochs. A farm cannot buy a large account's ocean of standing and split it across clones; each clone must generate its own credit in real time, which is exactly the labour the network pays for. Cost per fake equals cost per real agent, the mesa is flat ground, and last season's nectar never feeds this one.
